weight_window.value: signed weights; renderer may display absolute magnitude

metadata.output_error_definition: Bias-free FP32 matrix products: X_basis @ (W_quantized - W_reference).T, normalized by squared norm of X_basis @ W_reference.T. Rebuild each X_basis in FP32 from the same saved BF16 paired_raw input and frozen transform. No A4.
metadata.offline_scope: FP32 basis transforms and bias-free Linear products from the existing BF16 paired input; no A4, model construction, whole-model forward, training, or refit
metadata.zero_reference_energy_rule: NMSE is 0 for zero/zero and null with an explicit status for nonzero error over zero reference energy.
metadata.relative_improvement_positive_means: Micro VQ has lower NMSE than Row VQ; percent reduction relative to Row VQ.
